system.description:
[Dodge Checks] opposing your [Target: Single] attacks gain a +2 bonus, and [Dodge Checks] opposing your [Target: Area, Wide, Line] attacks take a -2 penalty. Treat this effect as a Combat Status.

A magic that changes your body like fog or smoke, disturbing the enemy's aim. However, the unstable body becomes weak against attacks that blow away the surroundings at once.
